record: owner-authorised standing rule for bookings of the authorised Telegram test drivers' synthetic shipments (Category E)
category_meaning: An approval-workflow execution whose shipment is a Telegram test driver's synthetic shipment (SYN-SHP-TEST-<n>), created on or after 26 Nov 2026, APPROVED by a person in the planner role through the hosted console. Category E accounts for the origin of such a booking (the owner's own two-driver Telegram testing and demo); it is never a passing smoke test, never smoke evidence and never satisfies the fresh-smoke requirement. The hard checks (synthetic shipment, pilot facility, execution status, transitions) still apply. A TEST-driver request that was rejected, expired or decided any other way is not covered. Defined in setuhaul/ops/renewal.py (TEST_DRIVER_SHIPMENT, TEST_DRIVER_RULE_FROM); changing the rule is a code change.

owner_confirmation.channel: Claude Code session (demo release DEMO-01, renewal attribution)
owner_confirmation.statement: Confirm + rule for TEST drivers: approvals 453358af and 251b0c87 (synthetic shipment SYN-SHP-TEST-1, FAC-JAI-01, approved by a planner in the hosted console at about 13:21 and 13:26 IST on 26 Nov 2026) were my own Telegram tests; and any SYN-SHP-TEST-* booking by the authorised Telegram test drivers, approved by a human planner in the console, counts as an owner test.
owner_confirmation.scope: origin of the authorised Telegram test drivers' console-approved bookings only
